Unconstrained Isosurface Extraction on Arbitrary Octrees
CODE DESCRIPTION The code provides an implementation of the isosurface extraction in the context of mesh-simplification. Given an input mesh, the Euclidean Distance Transform of the mesh is computed and an octree is adapted to the data, sampling the transform more finely near the surface of the mesh.
